name: Alert
purpose: Communicates a contextual message using semantic color from tokens.
scenarios: Inform the user about a successful action
Warn that a setting requires attention
Report an error that blocks a task

variants.name: status
variants.description: Semantic tone that maps to a token-derived accent color.

antiPatterns: Do not use an error alert for inline validation; use an invalid field.
Do not use success alerts for every minor action; reserve them for meaningful outcomes.

a11y.labeling: Title labels the alert region; description is associated.

responsive.strategy: Alert stretches to the parent inline size and wraps text on compact screens.

breakpoints.compact: Full inline size of the parent.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. The accent border is on the inline-start side.
